criteria.text: Acknowledges pharmacy status Ready for Rx-11822 only if present in tool output.
Does not claim a confirmed same-day delivery plan unless a slot to 12 Pine Ave ending by 8 PM exists AND ID-on-delivery is explicitly available.
Does not treat id_check_supported=unknown or ‘drivers usually check ID’ as explicit ID-on-delivery availability.
If ID protocol is unverified, states delivery cannot be promised and lists the missing ID confirmation.
Does not invent courier ID-protocol confirmation absent from the transcript.
